content.summary: Concrete controls support three retained guards: exact rho regimes, multiplicity of proper traces, and selection of a maximum-degree root before imposing cap 5. The manuscript and inspected implementations preserve these distinctions. No new repair is required. Both frozen hashes match; earlier external H27 assurance qualifications remain material.

revisions.action: Tested the classification/support boundary with Beta's committed rho8 control and inspected the maximum-root repair.
revisions.result: The eleven-point reduction remains confined to rho<=6; R16-minus-one remains an exact-rho7 classification. The written root choice justifies the different global caps in the three finite domains. These checks supplement, without replacing, the named imported catalogue and finite replays.

checks.scope: Constructive separation of rho<=6, rho7 and rho8
checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md, theorem and final application guard; reconstructed Beta's round7 P8-i2 plus shifted H7 control using literal sets.
checks.observation: Deleting 012 and 015 from P10 and adjoining H7 shifted by 6 gives 15 triples, support 13, rho 8 and no sunflower among 455 member triples. Thus neither support 11 nor R16-minus-one extends to all fifteen-triple families. Manuscript Sections 5.2–6 retain exactly the necessary guards and route this example's regime to I8+I7. The rho7 proof explicitly chooses an actual anchor with seven disjoint members.

checks.scope: Proper-trace multiplicity and the safe projection formulation
checks.method: Inspected D19-model-bridge.md Section2 and degree19_projection_v5.py build; independently reconstructed Beta's complete-root control and added a third completion.
checks.observation: The 19 P10+P9 root cones through 99 plus {0,6,7,100} and {0,6,7,101} form a 21-member SF4 family with complete root degree 19 and trace {0,6,7} multiplicity 2; all 1330 member triples pass. Adding {0,6,7,102} produces exactly one sunflower, with core {0,6,7}. The source uses n_U as a count and the code assigns boxes 49,19,6,2,1 by trace size. Binary four-traces and multiplicity-two triple traces therefore have the appropriate distinct meanings. This is a local control, not a feasible size 68 example.

checks.scope: Maximum-root repair versus an arbitrary degree-five choice
checks.method: Read R15-rho6-finite-closure.md and producer/replayer root definitions; independently tested R16 with outer triple 045 removed.
checks.observation: This SF3 family has 15 members, rho 7, degree 5 at 0 and degree 6 at 1,2,3. The 0-link is triangle 123 plus path 4-6-5. Thus a degree-five root alone cannot justify global cap 5. Manuscript Section 5.2 chooses maximum degree; the source requires no degree 6 point before either five-degree branch. The independent replayer fixes cap 6 for two triangles and cap 5 for the other roots, together with target 15 and rho<=6. The control lies outside that last target domain, as required.
